editorialSceneSources.title: Moonlit Farewell
editorialSceneSources.summary: Fantine holds Cosette close on a cold Paris street before leaving her with the Thenardiers' promise.

visualIntent.purpose: show the cost of survival before the reader sees the later fall

rendererExpression.environment: narrow Paris street at night, wet cobblestones, one dim lantern

characters.visual: thin woman in worn shawl, mid-ground left, face partly turned away
small child clutched to the woman's chest, face nestled, distant soft focus

rendererExpression.action: woman holding the child tightly before releasing her toward an unseen doorway
rendererExpression.composition: medium wide shot, mother-child left of center, dark street receding right
rendererExpression.lighting: single lantern side light, cold blue ambient

editorialSceneSources.title: Factory Dismissal
editorialSceneSources.summary: Fantine is turned out of the workshop; the street becomes her only horizon.

visualIntent.purpose: mark the social ejection that begins her descent

rendererExpression.environment: factory yard gate at dusk, brick walls, muddy ground

characters.visual: lone woman outside closed gate, shawl tight, face lowered

rendererExpression.action: standing alone after the gate has shut
rendererExpression.composition: wide shot, small figure against large closed gate
